description: This file contains the implementation of serialization codecs, surrogates, and deep copiers for ReadOnlyDictionary<TKey, TValue> in Orleans, including classes ReadOnlyDictionaryCodec, ReadOnlyDictionarySurrogate, and ReadOnlyDictionaryCopier.

classes.name: ReadOnlyDictionaryCodec<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Codec class for serializing and deserializing ReadOnlyDictionary instances using surrogates.

classes.name: ReadOnlyDictionarySurrogate<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: A surrogate struct for ReadOnlyDictionary used during serialization.

classes.name: ReadOnlyDictionaryCopier<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Class responsible for deep copying ReadOnlyDictionary instances.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a surrogate back to a ReadOnlyDictionary.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a ReadOnlyDictionary to its surrogate form.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a ReadOnlyDictionary instance.
